subject: religious-studies

items.q: Do all Christians read the Bible in exactly the same way?
items.correct: No — some read it literally, others symbolically or in context.
items.misconception: Yes, all Christians interpret it identically and literally.
items.random_wrong: Christians do not use the Bible.
items.why: Interpretation varies across denominations and individuals.

items.q: How many gods does Christianity teach?
items.correct: One — Christianity is monotheistic; the Trinity is one God in three persons.
items.why: The Trinity (Father, Son, Holy Spirit) is understood as one God.

items.q: Do all Christians worship in the same way?
items.correct: No — practice varies widely (Catholic, Orthodox, Protestant).
items.why: Forms of worship, sacraments and church structures differ between denominations.
